Defines the `fetch` parent command for retrieving vulnerability dictionaries, registering shared persistent flags used by all fetch subcommands.

## Key Components

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `fetchCmd` | Cobra command registered under `RootCmd` that groups vulnerability fetch subcommands |
| `--no-details` | Persistent flag (bool, default `false`) to skip fetching vulnerability details |
| `--batch-size` | Persistent flag (int, default `25`) controlling the number of records per database insert batch |

## Usage Example

```bash
# Fetch with default settings
fleetmdm fetch

# Fetch without vulnerability details
fleetmdm fetch --no-details

# Fetch with a custom batch size
fleetmdm fetch --batch-size 50
```

Both flags are bound to [Viper](https://github.com/spf13/viper) so they can also be set via environment variables or a config file:

```bash
# Via environment variable
NO_DETAILS=true fleetmdm fetch
BATCH_SIZE=100 fleetmdm fetch
```

## Notes

- This file defines only the **parent** `fetch` command; actual fetch logic lives in subcommands (e.g., `fetch nvd`, `fetch oval`) that call `fetchCmd.AddCommand(...)`.
- Flags declared here as `PersistentFlags` are automatically inherited by all child subcommands.

**Source:** [`commands/fetch.go`](https://github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/blob/main/commands/fetch.go)
